content.title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation - Reviewers
content.header: Declarations of interest reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during development period up to and including 2023).

Details: Payment from healthcare industry to department/institution or other body for personal services: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc.
Companies/Areas: Pfizer: Atrial Fibrillation (AF); Daiichi-Sankyo: Atrial Fibrillation (AF); Boehringer Ingelheim: Atrial Fibrillation (AF); BMS: Atrial Fibrillation (AF).

Research funding from healthcare industry under direct/personal responsibility to department/institution: Boehringer-Ingelheim: AF registries [unrestricted educational grant]. Academic, non-promotional research work on registries. Principal Investigator.
Other interests: Shares in private limited company (legal separate entity in UK), no salary/dividends/income/personal remuneration received.
